Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to determine the interactome of XPO1. Label-free quantification (LFQ) is inferred from the comparison of IP vs Ig control groups without mention of isotopic tags.

scope: IP of XPO1 was performed with 15 µL of Dynabeads Protein A and 0.15 µg of anti-XPO1 Ab (PLA0109, Sigma-Aldrich) per mg of total protein extract.

XPO1 was eluted in a buffer containing 50 mM Tris (pH8.5), 2% SDS, 20 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and 50 mM chloroacetamide, heated for 5 min at 95 °C and trypsin-digested overnight using S-trap micro spin columns
XPO1 complexes were separated and subsequently used for trypsin digestion and MS analysis on four biological replicates from the three PMBL cell lines.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material specifically isolated via immunoprecipitation (IP) of XPO1 and its interacting partners, rather than on whole cell lysates.
